earlier_work_kept_on_this_branch: Previous pass (tested 4697f27, reviewed head f4f9222 found its code sound): P1 internal/core/app.go MigrateSealed unseal window: core migrate no longer hands the append-only tables to togavsu_app for the run. db.ApplySealed (internal/db/ledgers.go) runs the migrations on one superuser session switched to the application role with SET ROLE, so every object a migration creates still belongs to togavsu_app. A migration whose SQL names an append-only table gets only those tables handed to togavsu_app at the start of its own transaction, and ledgerseal.Script seals them again before that transaction commits. Postgres DDL is transactional, so no other session, including the old core serving during an update, ever sees a ledger it could change, and a failed, cancelled or killed migration rolls the handoff back. Migrations that name no ledger run with no handoff and take no lock on the ledgers. With nothing pending, core migrate only re-runs the seal, which also repairs a database an older core migrate left unsealed. db.UnsealLedgers is removed. Regression tests: TestLedgersSealedForApplicationRole fails a ledger migration (1/0 after an ALTER), then kills the migrating backend with pg_terminate_backend mid-migration, checks with db.VerifySealed on the application role's connection that the ledgers are sealed while it runs and after it dies, and that neither column exists; an expand migration still applies through db.ApplySealed and the admin pool session returns as the superuser. TestWrapLedgerMigration checks where the handoff and seal go in the Up section, that only named tables are handed over, and that unrelated migrations are unchanged. The remaining lock window is recorded as a second ceiling on PONYTAIL-DEBT.md Contracts item 4.
